info.title: croit LLM Gateway — session API (/api/v0)
info.description:
Session-authenticated JSON API used by the web UI (the SvelteKit SPA at /app and, during the migration, the legacy server-rendered pages).

SCOPE (issue #22 phase 1): the /api/v0/* surface only. The OpenAI-compatible /v1/* proxy is documented in docs/gateway-api.md and is intentionally NOT part of this spec — it is a byte-relay to upstream providers whose schema is OpenAI's, not ours. /auth/* is a browser redirect flow (not JSON). The ~150 form-POST page routes are the legacy surface phases 3-5 delete.

Hand-maintained rather than derived from code annotations: the wire types in shared::api use jiff::Timestamp (no schemars derive) and the surface churns every phase of #22, so code-first annotations (utoipa) would be re-annotated constantly. THE CONTRACT IS ENFORCED, NOT ASPIRATIONAL: tests/it/openapi_drift.rs fails CI when this spec and the routes registered in src/rama_server/router.rs drift apart in either direction — exactly the shape the generated TS client (openapi-typescript, wired in phase 2) will trust.

Auth: every endpoint is session-gated by the signed session cookie set at /auth/callback (401 OpenAI-envelope when absent/expired). RAG endpoints additionally require the admin role (403).

Persists the user turn, reserves the per-user worker slot, and spawns the turn. 202 the moment the worker starts; the reply streams on GET /api/v0/chat/sessions/{id}/events. One live turn per user: a second submit while one streams answers 409.

409.description: This user's previous turn is still streaming.

post.summary: Ask the live turn to stop
post.description: Flips the worker's cancel flag; the turn finalises as cancelled at its next checkpoint. Idempotent: nothing running means cancelled=false, not an error.

200.description: Whether a live worker was flagged.

get.summary: The JSON-SSE event stream of one conversation
get.description: Server-sent events with JSON payloads. Attach semantics: a snapshot event first (the DB replay — reconnecting needs no Last-Event-ID because the snapshot subsumes everything missed), then, when a worker is live for this session, deltas until turn_finalized and the stream closes; when nothing is live, an idle event and the stream closes immediately. Clients close their EventSource on turn_finalized/idle so the auto-reconnect doesn't loop a quiet session. Event names: snapshot, turn_delta, reasoning_delta, tool_call_started, tool_call_done, turn_finalized, sidebar_changed, info, tool_prompt, idle.
